title: DETECTion of PeriOperative Atrial Fibrillation After Noncardiac Surgery
official: Enhanced DETECTion of PeriOperative Atrial Fibrillation After Noncardiac Surgery with Continuous Electrocardiographic Monitoring
summary: This is a multicentre prospective cohort study where patients will receive up to 14 days of continuous ECG monitoring by wearing a portable monitoring device, starting within 72 hours after noncardiac surgery.
